x: Otherwise, the jumps were generally decimated by injury with the exception of the high jump where Warren Caswell leapt a season's best of 2.15 metres to get close to Dalton Grant.

It was a great afternoon for the British as well, started by high jumper Dalton Grant of Haringey. Cheerfully acknowledging our support he played a waiting game, passing at British record height, then setting a Commonwealth Record but so narrowly missing the medals.
